I design digital solutions that turn needs into concrete tools: websites, automations, data, AI and delivery.

items.name: Custom websites & apps
items.title: Tools that do the job
items.p1: A brochure site is fine. A website or app that answers a precise need — booking, catalogue, member area, dashboard — is better. I design clear, fast tools with no vendor lock-in.
items.p2: Astro, React, PHP, Supabase or Postgres depending on the need: the right tool, not the trendiest one. You keep the code and the keys.

items.name: AI & automation
items.title: Your time-saving machine
items.p1: Automatic summaries, request triage, content generation, follow-up scenarios: AI is useful when it removes a specific chore. I plug models into your data and tools, with guardrails.
items.p2: Result: hours recovered every week, and a system you understand and can evolve.

items.name: Google & AI visibility
items.title: Be found, be cited
items.p1: Your clients search on Google, and increasingly ask ChatGPT, Perplexity or Gemini directly. I measure your real visibility in those engines, then work on your site so it ranks and gets cited.
items.p2: With Beneloo I built an AI visibility score and a sector observatory: numbers, not promises.

items.name: CRM & conversion funnels
items.title: No more lost contacts
items.p1: A lead with no answer within 24h is a lost lead. I set up a simple CRM that centralises your leads, exchanges and appointments, with automatic follow-ups.
items.p2: Form, calendar, payment, emails: everything is connected. You stay responsive even in meetings or on holiday.

items.name: IT project delivery
items.title: Deliver, by the book
items.p1: Twenty years of IT projects, including several in regulated pharmaceutical environments: scoping, planning, quality, validation, change management. I run your projects with method, from idea to production.
items.p2: Specifications, supplier follow-up, testing, documentation: one contact who speaks both business and tech.

items.name: Training & coaching
items.title: Make your teams autonomous
items.p1: A tool is useless if nobody uses it. I train your teams on AI, on the tools I set up and on good practices, in short, practical sessions.
items.p2: Materials, workshops, follow-up: the goal is that you no longer need me.

process.label: Process
title: 5 steps
to launch.
process.intro: From the first call to launch,

items.title: Analysis & objectives
items.text: We start with a real conversation: your business, your clients, what is stuck today. No ready-made solution — I first look for where time and leads are being lost.

items.title: Build plan
items.text: I draw the full journey: who uses the tool, what they see, what triggers action. Every screen and every automation has a precise role.

items.title: Tool & integrations
items.text: I build the tool and connect it to what exists: calendar, form, CRM, database. A clean, fast system you can evolve without depending on anyone.

items.title: AI & follow-ups
items.text: Everything that can be automated is: follow-ups, summaries, triage, confirmations. You answer within 24h even when swamped.

items.title: Measure & optimise
items.text: Launch, test, measure. We look at the numbers together, adjust what needs adjusting, and the tool improves month after month.

about.intro: Who I am, what I do,
paragraphs: My name is Benjamin de Bruijne. I live in Belgium, near Brussels, and I have worked in IT for over twenty years — over 200 web projects built or delivered: development, project management, product, quality, digital transformation.

I have led projects in highly regulated environments (pharmaceutical industry) and built, in parallel, my own products: Service-Volée, BiblioPulse, and an ecosystem around control of data: Beneloo (SME visibility in AI engines), the Observatory (the measurement, sector by sector) and Singulr, the non-profit I chair, which operates sovereign digital commons including a Git forge hosted in Belgium.

That double track is my edge: the rigour of a large group, the speed of a freelancer. I can scope, document and deliver by the book, and I can also code a complete tool in a few days when that is what is needed.
I work through my company, Hakuna Matata SRL, and I pick tools that leave you in control: code you own, data at home, no opaque subscriptions.
